dashboard.strapline: Wurk, wurk. Ready to work. Zug zug.
dashboard.tagline: A 100% drop-in replacement for Sidekiq + Sidekiq Pro + Sidekiq Enterprise. Free forever. Faster.
dashboard.no_history: No history yet — the chart fills in as jobs run.

summaries.queues: Active queues with their depth and latency — click a queue to inspect its jobs.
summaries.retries: Jobs that raised an error and are scheduled to run again — click one for the error and backtrace.
summaries.scheduled: Jobs enqueued to run at a future time.
summaries.dead: Jobs that exhausted every retry — click one to inspect the failure.
summaries.busy: Live worker processes and the jobs they're currently running.
summaries.batches: Batched jobs and their progress, successes, and failures.
summaries.limiters: Rate limiters and their current usage.
summaries.cron: Periodic (cron) jobs with their schedule and last run — click a loop to see its execution history.
summaries.metrics: Throughput and failure history, with per-job execution stats.
summaries.profiles: Captured job profiles — open one in the Firefox profiler to inspect its flame graph.
summaries.search: Find a job across retries, scheduled, and dead by JID or class name.

busy.no_running: No jobs currently running on this process

search.emptyHint: Enter a JID or class name (2+ characters) and hit Search. Results span retries, scheduled, and dead jobs.

extension.notRendered: This tab is provided by a third-party extension. wurk surfaces it in the nav but doesn't render its view inside the dashboard.

actions.pause_hint: Stop fetching new jobs from this queue (in-flight jobs finish)
actions.unpause_hint: Resume fetching jobs from this queue
actions.confirm_clear_queue: Clear all jobs from "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
